articles.author: ACCESS Newswire
articles.headline: KIDZ AI Enters into $44.6 Million Definitive GPU Compute Services Agreement with Canopy Wave
articles.summary: KIDZ announced a five-year GPU services agreement with stated aggregate value of $44.6 million, conditioned on a subsidiary placing a noncancelable server order. Contract value is not recognized revenue or proof that the infrastructure was already deployed.
